Every artistic vision has a model
Give your content the right look with the model you really need
Photorealism Illustration Cinematic 3D render Concept art Vector & brand
Photorealism
Lifelike detail and lighting for product and editorial shots.
Flux 2 Pro
A fast, production-grade Flux.2 model. Generates and edits images up to 2K with strong photorealism, accurate text rendering, and support for up to 10 reference images . Suited for most professional use cases and high-volume workflows where speed and quality need to coexist.
Nano Banana Pro
Combines advanced generation and precise image editing with studio-quality control. Edit images via natural language, adjust camera angles, modify lighting, and combine up to 14 reference images in a single request. Powered by Gemini 3 Pro’s reasoning and real-world knowledge for accurate infographics, multilingual text rendering, and context-rich visuals up to 4K.
Nano Banana 2
Delivers pro-level generation and editing at flash speed , with photorealistic output, vibrant lighting, richer textures, and accurate multilingual text rendering. Edit images with natural language: change backgrounds, swap objects, or apply styles from reference images without manual masking. Maintains character consistency across up to five subjects and 14 objects in a single workflow. Supports resolutions from 1K to 4K.
Seedream 5
The first in the family to incorporate real-time web retrieval and chain-of-thought visual reasoning into the generation process. Strong prompt adherence, precise in-image text, and consistent subject handling across generations up to 4K.
Seedream 4.5
A comprehensive upgrade over Seedream 4. Adds multi-image fusion, sharper spatial reasoning, and improved 4K output quality . Supports reference images and offers more consistent character and aesthetic control across complex prompts.
GPT Image 2
A major leap in photorealism and in-image text rendering. Ideal for portraits, product shots, and UI mockups requiring exceptional detail and accuracy.
GPT Image 1.5
OpenAI’s standard image model. Delivers consistent, coherent visuals with fast, reliable generation . A dependable choice for most creative and commercial tasks.
Krea 2
Krea 2 is the foundation image model built from scratch for creatives who steer their work. Now on Magnific.
Recraft V4
A production-ready model for structured composition and precise typography rendering. Delivers 1K resolution outputs optimized for professional design workflows. Suitable for branding systems, posters, and campaign visuals that require layout compatibility and consistent results.
Illustration
Bold, graphic styles for posters, covers and key art.

The image model built for design. Write a plain-language prompt and generate realistic 2K visuals with in-image text that actually reads, art-directed composition, and color that stays on brand. Now on Magnific.
Cinematic
Cinematic frames with depth, grain and dramatic light.
Sora 2
Create videos with complex movement and natural pacing. Sora 2 handles narrative depth and visual accuracy with ease.
Google Veo 3.1
Generate high-quality videos with realistic physics, synced audio, and expressive voices. This model offers strong motion control and scene depth.
Runway Gen 4.5
Create professional videos with natural camera flow and prompts that deliver exactly what you describe across photorealistic, animated, or artistic styles.
Kling 3.0
Generates clips up to 15 seconds with native multilingual audio and multi-shot capabilities that create connected scenes in one go.
Kling 3.0 Motion Control
Upgraded movement and expression transfer from any video reference with smoother flow and bolder emotional range.
Kling 2.6
Kling’s cinematic generative power, now with built-in audio for dialogue, narration, music, and sound effects.
Kling 2.6 Motion Control
Track and recreate face expressions, body motion, and hand gestures with Kling’s signature cinematic quality.
Kling O1
Create consistent scenes using prompts, images, or clips, thanks to Kling’s multimodal reference system .
Seedance 2
State-of-the-art generation with image, video, and audio references, precise camera control, and multi-shot storytelling with consistent characters across scenes.
Seedance 1.5 Pro
Cinematic videos with built-in audio and style transfer.
WAN 2.6
With Wan 2.6 you can create multi shot clips up to 15s. This model supports text, images, and reference videos as input, and includes native audio generation.
MiniMax H3
The breakout new video model . Cinematic motion and sharp detail, straight from your prompt.
MiniMax Hailuo 2.3
Precision-tuned for expressive movement, with seamless transitions and native visual effects.
PixVerse 5.5
Up to 10s videos with 1-3 shots, native audio, start + end frame references, and multiple styles.
Grok Imagine
Designed to create dynamic videos with natural motion and clear visual progression. Ideal for testing ideas, exploring timing, and understanding how concepts work in motion.
Happy Horse 1
Happy Horse thinks in sequences. It syncs audio to every frame, preserves identity across references, and edits existing footage without breaking the motion. Up to 15 seconds of 1080p.
